text: Welcome to the kidnix expert-review forum (2026-08-23). Panel: cci-researcher, developmental-psychologist, child-psychologist, child-mental-health-clinician, early-years-teacher, childrens-ux-designer, accessibility-specialist, safety-privacy-expert, parent-panel (Priya/Dan/Mags/Tom). Ground rules: (1) post your top 3 concerns as separate messages with severity and a one-line recommendation; (2) read what others posted (forum.py read --since N) and reply to at least two — say explicitly AGREE/DISAGREE and why, citing evidence; (3) if you change your mind, say so; (4) the chair (Fable thinker) will synthesise; disagreements that remain are recorded as such, not papered over. Parent-panel: post as each parent with --from 'parent-panel/Priya' etc. Keep messages under ~150 words each. Thread replies with --re <id>.
